heading: CV
title: CV – Nye Warburton
description: Public CV for Nye Warburton, Dean of STEC at SCAD. Credits as listed on the public CV.
tagline: Educator / Creative Technologist / Animator / Game Developer
quote: I teach artists to build for what’s coming.
presentNote: Present role is Dean of STEC at SCAD. The source page still lists Chair, ITGM.
intro: I am Dean of the School of Creative Technology (STEC) at Savannah College of Art and Design (SCAD). My mission is to prepare students for competitive careers in gaming and interactive media – with an eye towards AI workflows, networked production and immersive technologies.

I have over 20 years of experience across animated films, TV commercials, and video games. Past credits include Monster House, Avengers, Oblivion, and Men in Black III. As a contractor and entrepreneur, I have built apps, virtual reality, and gamified software experiences.

Now I focus on educating and mentoring the next generation of digital artists, designers and game developers. As a technical artist, I spend time researching and cultivating the real-time workflows for the deployment of student games and interactive experiences. As a thinker, I write and speak to imagine the art of tomorrow.
I collaborate with anyone eager to push boundaries. My interests span many intersections of technology and creativity – like games, comics, animation, AI, web3, comedy, philosophy and storytelling.
